title_en: Telephone Reply of the Research Office of the Supreme People's Court on How to Determine the Amount of Fraud in the Case of Shen Fuqiang's Fraud

articles.content_en:
Telephone Reply of the Research Office of the Supreme People's Court
on How to Determine the Amount of Fraud in the Shen Fuqiang Fraud Case
(April 23, 1991)

Higher People's Court of Henan Province:

Your court's Request for Instructions on How to Determine the Amount of Fraud in the Shen Fuqiang Fraud Case (Yu Fa (Yan) Qing [1991] No. 15) has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:

We agree with your court's preferred opinion. That is, when specifically determining the amount of fraud crime, the amount of defrauded money that has been recovered before the case was discovered shall be deducted, and the calculation shall be based on the actual amount of fraud proceeds finally obtained. However, when imposing punishment, this circumstance shall be considered as an aggravating factor.

Appendix:

Request for Instructions of the Higher People's Court of Henan Province
on How to Determine the Amount of Fraud in the Shen Fuqiang Fraud Case

April 1, 1991 Yu Fa (Yan) Qing [1991] No. 15

Supreme People's Court:

Recently, the Intermediate People's Court of Puyang City requested instructions from our court on how to determine the amount of fraud in the Shen Fuqiang fraud case.

The defendant, Shen Fuqiang, by means of deception, entered into a contract with Jiangsu Province Xinyi County Winery in October 1987 for various kinds of qu wine valued at 106,200 yuan. Before the case was discovered, Xinyi County Winery recovered qu wine worth 61,086.24 yuan, and the remaining 45,113.76 yuan could not be recovered.

Regarding this case, the Adjudication Committee of our court has two opinions: One opinion holds that, for determining the amount of fraud by Shen Fuqiang, the more than 60,000 yuan recovered before the case was discovered may be deducted and considered as an aggravating factor when sentencing, and the amount shall be determined as the remaining more than 45,000 yuan. The other opinion holds that Shen Fuqiang had already fraudulently obtained qu wine worth more than 100,000 yuan, so the amount of fraud shall be calculated based on the total contract value, which constitutes a huge amount, and the more than 60,000 yuan recovered may be considered as a mitigating factor when sentencing.

We prefer the first opinion.

Please approve.
